verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented setting to opt out of telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. The only privacy evidence says AI features are opt-in, so space data is not shared with third-party AI services unless AI is activated. That is a related but different control: it covers AI data sharing, not telemetry or usage tracking, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
